shortVersion: xAI's Grok 4.6 model has been added to the GitHub Copilot model lineup, expanding the choices available to developers when working with Copilot's AI assistance.
More model choices in Copilot lets developers pick the best tool for each task; Grok 4.6 adds another competitive option alongside existing Anthropic and Google models.
